staged_candidates.similarity: Both texts urge believers not to divide.
staged_candidates.difference: Paul addresses divisions in the Corinthian church and agreement in mind; Qur'an 3:103 recalls reconciliation of enemies through divine grace and the rope of God, while 3:105 warns of post-revelation division.
staged_candidates.verification: English primary translation inspected; Greek critical text, textual witnesses and reception not collated.

staged_candidates.similarity: Both speak of a religious community with a distinctive God-related status and vocation.
staged_candidates.difference: 1 Peter describes a chosen priestly people proclaiming God's acts; Qur'an 3:110 defines exemplary status by commanding right, forbidding wrong and faith, alongside a People-of-the-Book polemic.
staged_candidates.verification: English primary translation inspected; Greek critical text and compositional/dating scholarship not collated.
